# ExtractPDF

> Pay-per-use PDF and DOCX text extraction for AI agents.
> $0.01 USDC per extraction. No API key. No account. No subscription.
> Accepts payment on Base, Arc, and Polygon via x402 v2 and MPP.

## What it does

POST a public URL of a PDF or DOCX document and receive:
- Clean extracted plain text (up to 50,000 characters)
- Page count and document metadata (PDF)
- Format detection (pdf / docx / text)

## Endpoint

POST https://www.extractpdf.xyz/api/extract
Content-Type: application/json

Body: { "url": "https://example.com/document.pdf" }

## Payment

Price: $0.01 USDC per call (10000 atomic units, 6 decimals)
Networks: Base (eip155:8453), Arc (eip155:5042), Polygon (eip155:137)
Protocol: x402 v2 (scheme "exact", EIP-3009) and MPP

1. Send the POST without payment. The response is HTTP 402 with a base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header
   (x402 v2) listing one option per network. Each option carries extra.name and extra.version
   (the USDC EIP-712 domain), so standard x402 clients can sign without a token table.
2. Sign a USDC authorization for one option and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.
3. Receive the extracted JSON.

## Response example

{
  "url": "https://example.com/report.pdf",
  "text": "Executive Summary\n\nThis report covers...",
  "pages": 12,
  "chars": 8432,
  "format": "pdf",
  "extracted_at": "2026-11-03T12:00:00.000Z"
}

## Supported formats

- PDF (.pdf): full text and metadata extraction
- DOCX (.docx): full text extraction
- Plain text: returned as-is

## Links

- Homepage: https://www.extractpdf.xyz
- OpenAPI spec: https://www.extractpdf.xyz/openapi.json
- Payment probe: GET https://www.extractpdf.xyz/api/extract (returns 402)
